header.contentDescription: A Swiss lever escapement drawn as an X-ray: a fourth wheel driving the pinion on the escape arbor, a fifteen-tooth escape wheel that advances half a tooth per beat, a pallet lever snapping between its banking pins, and a balance wheel swinging four times a second over its hairspring. Every part is translucent, so the mechanism can be read through itself.
